title: build_credential_store inner/outer split preserves structured errors at module boundary
description: In imap/main.rs and reader/server_stores.rs, build_credential_store_inner returns BuildStoreError (matchable) while build_credential_store converts to String for the startup boundary. This pattern is correct: within the module errors remain structured and testable; at the startup boundary they become human-readable strings. Do not collapse to a single function returning String — that would lose the From<CredentialStoreError> auto-conversion.
